channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: UVA professor says peer threw plate at him over case about civil rights for straight woman
item.description: UVA law professor Xiao Wang said another faculty member threw a plate at him after he took on a case regarding discrimination against a heterosexual woman.

item.title: Leftists rip student for using Bible in assignment, ignore that male instructor believes he’s a woman
item.description: Samantha Fulnecky, a University of Oklahoma student, received a zero for a reaction paper critiquing gender theory from a Biblical perspective. Critics argue the grading was unjust, as the assignment required personal engagement, not scientific evidence. This incident highlights training deficiencies among college instructors, with some questioning the ethics of the grading decision.

item.title: Hunger-striking UC Berkeley lecturer suspended for anti-Israel politicking in class
item.description: UC Berkeley lecturer Peyrin Kao has been suspended for pro-Palestinian advocacy in class and a month-long hunger strike supporting Palestine. Critics call the suspension a violation of academic freedom, prompting student-led actions, including a planned hunger strike. Supporters assert it reflects broader issues regarding free speech on campus and a response to perceived political pressure.

item.title: ‘Dr. Antifa’ to teach seminars at Rutgers this spring
item.description: Professor Mark Bray, known as "Dr. Antifa," will teach seminars on "Communism" and "Fascism and Nazism" at Rutgers University this spring. Following controversial backlash and threats, he fled to Spain. Bray's academic work focuses on antifascism and he gained notoriety for his book, “Antifa: The Anti-Fascist Handbook.”

item.title: USC professors promote ‘drag pedagogy’ for K-12 teacher prep programs
item.description: USC professors Theodore Burnes and John Pascarella propose integrating "drag pedagogy" into K-12 teacher training to foster creativity and promote empathy. Their framework aims to counteract anti-drag sentiments, advocating for the inclusion of queer content and a shift away from binary gender notions, ultimately creating safer, more affirming educational environments for all students.

item.title: USC journalism school gives Jon Stewart, Rachel Maddow ‘outstanding political journalism’ award
item.description: Stewart is the first comedian to earn the award after taking on Trump.

item.title: Labor unions fight against housing for UC Berkeley students
item.description: Unions are trying to stop an affordable housing project aimed at college students unless certain demands are met.

item.title: Gen Z’ers ‘hungry for truth’: Record 52 students join Catholic Church at ASU
item.description: While Gen Z leads the rise of the religiously unaffiliated, Arizona State University is bucking the trend with a record 52 new Catholics this semester. item.title: White professor still fighting in court, alleging ‘racially hostile’ environment at Penn State
item.description: Zack De Piero, a former professor at Penn State, is appealing the dismissal of his lawsuit alleging a "racially hostile" environment due to the university's DEI trainings and race-based grading.
